content:
A fitting 2-word name for this group could be:

**"Paradox Lovers"**

This captures the contradictory nature of their traits—loving something they're allergic to and being passionate about something they don't understand. Alternatively, **"Contradictory Crew"** or **"Irony Enthusiasts"** could also work!
